reportSummary.narrative: Comprehensive analysis of phased WGS data for PROBAND_01 identified 1408 actionable variant calls across 1003 clinical genes. 33 findings were classified as Potential Concerns / Pathogenic, and 10 protective genetic factors were confirmed. Multi-system risk aggregation, polygenic risk, pharmacogenomic interactions, and functional ontology mappings have been evaluated across all anatomical systems.
